decisions.story_title: CVE-2026-90562: LangBot password recovery with 24 bits of entropy
decisions.reason: CVE-2026-90562, CVSS 8.1, LangBot before 4.10.11 generates password recovery keys with only 24 bits of entropy and no rate limit, allowing brute-force account takeover.

decisions.story_title: SIPp buffer overflow vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-90779, CVE-2026-90778, CVE-2026-90780)

decisions.story_title: CVE-2026-90777: ESPnet deserialization RCE via torch.load
decisions.reason: CVE-2026-90777, CVSS 8.8, ESPnet before 202609 deserializes pretrained models via torch.load with weights_only=False, allowing remote code execution.

decisions.story_title: CVE-2026-90776: Nodemailer quadratic time complexity vulnerability
